title: DNA Double Helix and Base-Pair Sequence
prompt:
Implement a DNA double helix using Three.js: the two backbones are parametric helical curves, with base pairs connecting the two strands.

[Three.js Import Method (Must Be Followed Strictly)]
Use the following importmap in <head>, and import via ES Modules in <script type="module">:
<script type="importmap">
{ "imports": {
    "three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js",
    "three/addons/": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/"
} }
</script>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';
</script>

[Geometry and Sequence]
(1) Double-helix backbone: two helical curves (for example, radius r and a phase difference of π), sampled along the curves using tubes or thin cylinders.
(2) Include a total of 20 base pairs. Hard-code a sequence string such as "ATCGATCGAATCGATCGATCG" (length 20), and map each position as follows: use red-green for A-T and blue-yellow for G-C (the colors may be fine-tuned, but they must remain distinguishable).
(3) Connect the corresponding sampled points on the two strands for each base pair using a short line or cylinder.

[Interaction]
(4) A rotation-speed slider with id="rotSpeed" (controls the overall self-rotation around the axis or scene rotation).
(5) A base-pair spacing slider with id="spacing" that changes the vertical spacing between adjacent bases in the helix.
(6) Clicking a base pair highlights it and displays its index and base character (A/T/G/C) in the DOM (for example, in an element with id="baseInfo" or a fixed area on the page).
(7) A button with id="unwindBtn": plays or toggles an "unwinding" animation that separates the two strands along the axis (isUnwinding is true, or the animation progress is reflected by the state).

[State Exposure (Required)]
Update window.__3D_STATE__ every frame:
  - basePairCount: number (20)
  - sequence: string (the 20-character sequence above)
  - rotSpeed: number
  - spacing: number
  - selectedBase: number | null (0–19 or null)
  - isUnwinding: boolean
  - helixRadius: number (the helix radius parameter)

Output a single HTML file.
difficulty_analysis: L4: Double-helix parametric equations, sequence and color mapping for 20 pairs, click picking, unwinding animation, and slider integration.
